name: QR code
summary: A scannable QR code — a join link, a deck URL, a Wi-Fi handoff — rendered through the shared QRCode.
lead: QR encoding and canvas rendering are real work best left to Ant's QRCode, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both framed once by the shared qrCodeTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look — ink modules on white in a 1px radius-8 frame. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

spec.label: Bordered
spec.value: off — the .aha-qr frame supplies the DS border (antd's own bordered defaults on)

props.name: value
props.desc: The URL or text to encode

props.name: status
props.desc: Render state — expired/scanned overlay a mask, loading shows a spinner

props.name: bordered
props.desc: antd's own 1px frame — off, so the .aha-qr container owns the DS frame

whenToUse.when: a link people scan from a screen with a phone — a join code, a deck URL, an app download
the destination is clicked, not scanned

opinion.note: Keep the encoded value short so the code stays low-density and scans fast. Always show the human-readable link or join code beside it as a fallback.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — antd v6 QRCode (ant-design-vue v4 in Vue), framed once by the shared qrCodeTheme; matrix: value · size (120/160/200) · errorLevel (L/M/Q/H) · status (active/expired/loading/scanned) · color + bgColor · icon · bordered (off — the .aha-qr container owns the DS frame). The DS keeps ink modules on white in a 1px radius-8 padding-16 frame; verified via Figma search_design_system against the DS V3 system-qr-code component (key 74513a3c66281fccc173cf04ebed74f404a7995e).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared qrCodeTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same qrCodeTheme + framing; residual drift is caught by visual regression.

selfCheck.label: canvas renders at the set size

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the measure reads the real antd v6 QRCode framed by the DS container bound to qrCodeTheme.
